en.headline: Passers-by report wild monkey foaming at mouth in Sham Shui Po
en.dek: Two people saw the animal near an oil station on Tai Po Road around 1am and called police and the SPCA; staff arrived after it had climbed a tree and left.
body: Two passers-by reported a wild monkey foaming at the mouth opposite an oil station at 338 Tai Po Road in Sham Shui Po around 1am on Sunday.
They notified police and the Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals. SPCA personnel went to the scene, but the monkey had already climbed a tree and left by the time they arrived.

The incident is the latest sighting of wild monkeys in urban areas. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department has previously said about 2,000 monkeys live in Hong Kong and has stepped up enforcement against illegal feeding.

zh.headline: 深水埔野猴口吐白泡 途人報案愛協到場時已爬樹離開
zh.dek: 凌晨約一時，兩名途人在大埔道338號油站對開發現野猴口吐白泡，報案及通知愛協，人員抵達時猴子已爬樹離去。
body: 深水埔發現疑似受傷的野猴。今日凌晨約一時，兩名途人先後經過大埔道338號一間油站對開時，發現一隻野猴口吐白泡，於是報案求助，並通知愛護動物協會。
愛協人員接獲通知後到場了解情況，惟野猴已經爬上樹離開。
這是近期市區再有野猴出沒的個案。漁農自然護理署早前表示本港約有二千隻猴子，並已加強打擊非法饋飼，以減少它們對人類食物的依賴。
